## Description

Proposed model for momentum/trend forecasting: Estimate directional or relative strength from historical prices, returns, or factor signals and translate the forecast into rankings or portfolio exposure; the forecast horizon and position rules are not specified. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
